events.summary: Orlo wonders whether they know the goblins are there.
events.quote: "You think they know we're here?"

events.summary: Nylea promises protection to those who seek it.
events.quote: "Those who seek my protection shall receive it."

events.summary: Tawnos says his master believes anything is achievable.
events.quote: "My master believes anything is achievable."

events.summary: Tuvasa declares her people have always been here and will remain.
events.quote: "My people have always been here, and here we shall remain."

events.summary: Nations of Bant stood united against a common threat, their war forgotten.
events.quote: Their war forgotten, the nations of Bant stood united in the face of a common threat.

events.summary: A figure claims Serra lives on through her.
events.quote: "Serra isn't dead. She lives on through me."

events.summary: Asha left Bant, ensuring the world would have protection and order in her absence.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Gideon cleansed the Ninth District and none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.
events.quote: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.

events.summary: Kruphix hid dire prophecies about humankind where humans would not find them.
events.quote: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

events.summary: Thalia says holy places are no longer sanctuary from death.
events.quote: "Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."

events.summary: Nicol Bolas threatens to punish with the very ground one flees on.
events.quote: "Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"

events.summary: Nissa Revane compares rampaging baloths to the angry land.
events.quote: "When the land is angry, so are they."

events.summary: Zurgo says he came seeking a challenge and found only his foe.
events.quote: "I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."

events.summary: Numa says Nissa's people angered Zendikar and faced its wrath, making Nissa the last of the animists.
events.quote: Her people angered Zendikar, and they faced the land's wrath.

events.summary: Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch while Bosh searches for the secrets of his past.
events.quote: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons' purpose is that the Eldrazi can be imprisoned; Jace asks how that worked last time.
events.quote: "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."

events.summary: Automatons at the Foundry of the Consuls unhitched themselves and pivoted to face Chandra.
events.quote: All around the foundry, automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

events.summary: Liliana Vess approves of what has been done to the Grim Backwoods.
events.quote: "I love what they've done with the place."

events.summary: Teysa Karlov declares the Orzhov reward greatness openly.
events.quote: "This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."

events.summary: Kiora says people worship anyone who answers their pleas when gods become apathetic.
events.quote: "When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."

events.summary: Trostani's influence spread vitality through the Conclave to the other guilds' dismay.
events.quote: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave

events.summary: Elspeth records that partisans unearthed a strange artifact giving them hope.
events.quote: The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact.
